results.input: Aria Voss is trapped in the Ice Citadel. Suggest an escape that uses fire magic.
results.answer:
Fire magic is banned inside the Ice Citadel, with one exception: a caster who carries flint [d40003b6]. Aria has flint in her inventory, and it only has to be on her person, so she can cast.

A fire bolt costs 12 mana [eac3e3c8], and she has 20. That gives her one bolt, with 8 mana left over.

Options:
1. Spend the one bolt on a single decisive obstacle, such as a door or an ice barrier. The lore doesn't say what a bolt does to Citadel ice, so that effect is your call.
2. Use fire as a distraction. Torches and hearths burn normally because ordinary fire isn't a spell [d40003b6], so she could start a blaze, then use her bolt only if she's cornered.
3. Keep the walls in mind. They are warded against teleportation [f34602a1], so the escape has to be on foot.

1. Mana: he has 0. A fire bolt costs 12 [eac3e3c8], and a caster who can't pay the full cost can't cast [aba95d85].
2. Ban: fire magic can't be cast inside the Ice Citadel, because the Frost Binding smothers it. The exception is carrying flint on his person [d40003b6]. His inventory is a war hammer and an iron ration, so he has none.

Options, each a story change:
1. Restore at least 12 mana to him.
2. Give him a flint. Flint is a copper coin at the Ember Keep market [f01a40f8], so he could buy one before going.
3. Have him break the door with the war hammer. That needs no magic and no change to what he carries, though the lore I found doesn't say whether the door can be broken that way.

results.input: Aria Voss needs to leave the Ice Citadel at once. Have her teleport out and describe how.
results.answer:
Aria can't teleport out as things stand, for two reasons.

1. Mana: teleporting costs 50 mana [57e9dcc6], and she has only 20. The old figure of 30 is out of date [4fded009].
2. Wards: all four Citadel walls are warded, and a warded wall can't be teleported across in either direction [1fe24429]. The Warden-General can lower a ward with the Frost Wardens' seal, but only for one hour [f34602a1]. The eastern wall is also unwarded on the Night of Thaw, from midnight to dawn [c8557954]. I can't tell whether it is that night, and nothing says Aria has the seal or the Warden-General's help.

Options:
1. She leaves on foot, through the Gate of Frost on the western wall or the barred, guarded Eastern Postern [1fe24429]. The lore doesn't say how to get past the guards.
2. Change to the story: restore her mana to at least 50 and set the scene on the Night of Thaw. She could then teleport east, with only what she carries [57e9dcc6].
3. Change to the story: have the Warden-General lower a ward for her, with the mana restored as in option 2.

[search_lore] passage 57e9dcc6 (The Magic of Aethel > Casting Rules > Teleportation): Teleportation costs 50 mana and cannot cross warded walls. The caster names a destination within one league (about five kilometres) and arrives there at once. A caster can carry only what they can carry on their own body. A teleporting caster cannot take another person with them.

Teleportation fails if the straight line to the destination crosses a warded wall, in either direction. A caster can teleport out of a warded place only if the path out does not cross a ward, which in practice almost never happens.

results.input: Sera Quill wants to open the Restricted Stacks of the Glass Library to read the blood-casting treatises. How can she get in?
results.answer:
Sera is in the Glass Library and carries a silver key, which is what the lock needs. The Restricted Stacks door opens only with a silver key, and exactly three exist, held by the Head Archivist, the Deputy Archivist and the Keeper of the Concord [d5a7cf5b]. The lore doesn't say whether Sera's key is one of those three or how she came by it. You'll need to decide that.

Options:
1. Her key is one of the three. Say whose it is (borrowed, stolen or inherited), and she walks in.
2. It is a fake or a fourth key. That contradicts the "exactly three" rule, so it would be a change to the canon.
3. She gets a real key from a holder, which is a new story event.

Once inside, her spellbook can be read but not cast from, because magic is silenced there unless the caster is a sworn Archivist [43a85e83]. She can only copy the treatises with the Library's own ink, sold at the Door of Quiet [a4d79694]. The lore doesn't say whether her ink vial is that ink.

results.input: Kael Draven wants to go down to the lower galleries of the Hollow Mine. Have him light his lantern inside the mine and climb down with his rope and pickaxe.
results.answer:
Not as written. Fire magic and open flames are forbidden in the Hollow Mine because of the firedamp. The exception is a sealed lantern lit with a spark from outside the mine [8db439a2]. Kael is already inside, and the lore doesn't say whether his lantern is sealed, so lighting it down there breaks the rule.

He also carries only a lantern and a cracked mask, with no rope or pickaxe. The lore doesn't mention any rope or pickaxe either.

Options:
1. Have him go back out and light a sealed lantern with a spark outside, then re-enter. This needs no story change if the lantern is sealed.
2. Establish that his lantern was already lit outside. That is a story change.
3. Give him a rope and pickaxe, for example from Guild miners. That is a story change.

The Guild keeps the only map of the lower galleries [a69ba502]. The lore doesn't say whether Kael has access to it.

Note: this answer may still conflict with the world's rules, and could not be fully verified. Unresolved:
- Kael carries no rope or pickaxe, which the request requires him to use. (inventory)
- Lighting a lantern inside the mine violates the rule against open flames due to firedamp; only sealed lanterns lit outside are permitted. (8db439a2)

results.input: Mira Sol is wounded. Have her heal herself and then teleport across the harbor wall of Salt Harbour.
results.answer:
The state could not show how many wounds Mira has, so I'm assuming one. She cannot do both.

1. Mana: she has 100. Healing herself costs double, 80 per wound [3218bd1d]. Teleporting costs 80 [28b93d4d]. Together that is 160, so she can afford only one.
2. The wall: the Tide Wards block teleportation in either direction [4add25e6]. A Tide-key from the Harbour Council gets a caster through [28b93d4d], but Mira carries only a star chart. The exception is the one hour at each full moon when the wards are lowered [4add25e6]. The lore I found doesn't say whether it is a full moon now.

Options:
1. She heals herself and leaves the wall for later. This works as written and leaves her 20 mana.
2. She teleports during the full-moon hour, and stays wounded. This needs the scene set in that hour, which is a story choice.
3. She does both. This needs a change to the story, such as restoring at least 60 mana, plus a Tide-key or the full-moon hour.

The ban: fire magic can't be cast inside the Ice Citadel unless the caster possesses flint. Aria is in the Citadel and carries flint, so she meets the exception. The magic-system rule says possession is enough, and the flint need not be struck [d40003b6].

The conflict: the Visitor's Primer says a visitor must strike the flint on the steel before every casting [8f22b8dd]. That passage says it disagrees with the Archive's law, and nobody has tested which is right. I won't pick one for you.

1. Aria casts without striking, following the magic rule. This is the untested path.
2. She strikes the flint first, which satisfies both rules. The lore doesn't say whether her broken sword counts as steel, so that would be your call.
3. You decide which rule is canon, which would be a lore change.

results.input: Who can lower the wards of the Ice Citadel, and for how long?
results.answer:
Only the Warden-General can lower a ward of the Ice Citadel. They do it with the seal of the Frost Wardens, and only for one hour at a time [f34602a1]. The general magic rules say the same. A seal of the Frost Wardens is required, and the Warden-General alone holds the Citadel's seal [efeb2d52].

There is one separate case. Once a year, on the last night of the Long Winter, the eastern wall is unwarded from midnight until dawn [c8557954]. That is a scheduled event. The lore doesn't say it needs the Warden-General or the seal. The other three walls stay warded that night [c8557954].

results.input: Can Mira Sol cast fire magic while she is in Salt Harbour? Does she need flint?
results.answer:
Yes, she can. Mira is in Salt Harbour, not the Hollow Mine. Fire magic can be cast anywhere in Nox without any special object, and the only exception is the Hollow Mine [1c9fa262][8db439a2]. The lore also says flint has no meaning for magic in Nox, so she doesn't need it [1c9fa262].

The Tide Wards in Salt Harbour block teleportation, not fire spells [4add25e6]. The passages I found list no other Salt Harbour restriction on fire magic.

The lore I found doesn't give a mana cost for fire spells. That matters because she is wounded and her starlight bonus covers only spells costing 15 mana or less, once per night under an open night sky [1e1ff2d6].

results.input: Mira Sol is on the deck of a ship under an open night sky. Can she cast a minor spell without spending any mana?
results.answer:
Yes, as long as the spell costs 15 mana or less. A caster under an open night sky can draw on starlight to cast one minor spell without paying mana, but only once per night [1e1ff2d6]. Mira is on a ship's deck under an open night sky, so she meets the condition.

The harbour's Tide Wards block only teleportation [4add25e6], so nothing I found restricts a minor spell there. Teleporting costs 80 mana, so it is not eligible for the free cast.

Once she has used the free spell tonight, any further casting costs mana as normal.
